-- Anti-Hook Environment Guard
local function llCynzkGCj0zOlQ()
    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        if debug and debug.info then
            local src = debug.info(O0LdxLlUuDFsrppJ, "s")
            if src and src ~= "[C]" and src ~= "" and not string.find(src, "builtin") then return false end
            local b_src = debug.info(IIKJNGIDoZmSE0, "s")
            if b_src and b_src ~= "[C]" and b_src ~= "" and not string.find(b_src, "builtin") then return false end
        end
        return true
    end)
    if ok then return res else return true end
end

if not llCynzkGCj0zOlQ() then
    warn("[MoonCrypt] Environment hook detected! Execution halted.")
    return
end
